name: Loot With a Job
jem_summary: Use two techniques: heavy-armor rolling, chained whip damage, skull parry or leggings wall-climb. Emu-leggings evasion also qualifies. The kimono does not clear an existing undead target and does not count for this goal.

pages.title: Loot With a Job
pages.text: Wildlife equipment grants abilities beyond ordinary armour.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Roller armor rolls but sinks; Murmur tendons make the whip and Skelewag skull provides parrying. Centipede legs make wall-climbing leggings; Emu leggings separately evade projectiles.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Brew and drink one potion: Poison Resistance, Bug Pheromones or Soulsteal. A rattlesnake rattle turns Poison into Poisonous Essence; a centipede leg leads to resistance. Cockroach wings give pheromones. A Soul Vulture heart relates to health theft. Lava Vision and Clinging are in the adjacent route.
